evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: Complex undersurface tear at the body/posterior horn junction and posterior horn with meniscal extrusion into the inferior gutter.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: Cartilage heterogeneity and surface fraying along the inner weightbearing femoral articular surface.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Cartilage heterogeneity and surface fraying along the weightbearing central tibial articular surface.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full thickness cartilage fissuring with subchondral cystic change along the upper patellar median ridge, lower central and medial trochlear groove.
evidence.Contusion: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
evidence.Fracture: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
